captions: 8:15 p.m. A desert fire. Your best friend, two metres away.
Both of you typing. In the same group chat.
Then the fire cracks. He puts his phone face down.
He looks up at the stars: “When did we last pray together?”
8:40 p.m. Two friends. One masjid. Isha.
The One closest to you was never in the chat. Waiting for one word.

post.caption:
312 messages in the group chat today. Not one word to Allah. 📱

“We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.” (50:16)

Tonight at Isha: phone down, and bring a friend with you. Tag the one you want to pray with. 🤍
